checkedAlternates.risk: Quaternary is part of the Cenozoic Era.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Quaternary is the current youngest period (group-1), separated from the two earlier Cenozoic periods Paleogene and Neogene (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Triassic is the earliest dinosaur period.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Triassic begins the Mesozoic Era (group-3), following the Paleozoic Era (group-4).
